hypothesis_origin: Generated by the frozen MAPPPD observation that all three increasing regional Pygoscelis networks ended with lower effective breeding-site number; this SMP contract is an independent test and does not reinterpret MAPPPD as confirmatory evidence.

state_variables.N_it: annual total breeding abundance in frozen species x MasterSite panel i
state_variables.E_it: inverse-Simpson effective number of retained SiteID components, 1/sum_j(p_ijt^2)
state_variables.b_i: OLS slope of log1p(N_it) on centered year
state_variables.gamma_obs_i: OLS slope of log(E_it) on centered year using only frozen complete years with N_it>0

fixed_composition_null.q_ij: pooled count share of retained component j across all complete years in panel i
preserve: exact empirical annual panel totals N_it
the frozen positive-total year set used for E and gamma
fixed_composition_null.simulate: For integer count units, draw multinomial(N_it, q_i). If the retained SMP unit is not integer-valued, stop and freeze a unit-specific null before computing concentration outcomes rather than silently rounding.
fixed_composition_null.observation_error: Primary null uses raw observed counts only. Estimated/hidden-estimate records are excluded by the structural contract. No post-outcome error model is added.

interpretation.negative: excess temporal concentration beyond the exact abundance trajectory under fixed composition

primary_macro_model.overall_species_balanced_mean: For each species, average delta_gamma_i across its eligible panels; alpha_species is the unweighted mean of those species means.
primary_macro_model.abundance_coupling: Standardize b_i across all Stage-C panels, residualize both z(b_i) and delta_gamma_i by species mean, then estimate beta_within = sum(x_res*y_res)/sum(x_res^2).
primary_macro_model.weighting: Equal panel weight within species for species means; equal species weight for alpha_species. beta_within is a species-fixed-effect slope.

bootstrap.scheme: Resample species with replacement and retain all panels of each selected species; duplicate sampled species contribute with multiplicity.

confirmatory_support.overall_concentration: Supported only if the 95% species-bootstrap upper bound for alpha_species is <0.
confirmatory_support.decline_coupling: Supported only if the 95% species-bootstrap lower bound for beta_within is >0.
confirmatory_support.no_independence_by_nonsignificance: A beta interval containing zero is unresolved and cannot be called trend-independence.

primary_macro_model.minimum_identifiability: beta_within is reported confirmatorily only if >=4 species have at least two eligible panels with nonzero within-species b_i variance.

secondary_trend_class_contrast.increasing_mean: Within each species represented among increasing panels, average delta_gamma across its increasing panels; mu_plus is the unweighted mean of those species means.
secondary_trend_class_contrast.declining_mean: Within each species represented among declining panels, average delta_gamma across its declining panels; mu_minus is the unweighted mean of those species means.
secondary_trend_class_contrast.uncertainty: Use the same 9999-resample species-cluster bootstrap and percentile 95% intervals separately for mu_plus and mu_minus.

outcome_patterns.reversible_tracking: mu_minus 95% upper bound <0 AND mu_plus 95% lower bound >0
outcome_patterns.directional_persistence: mu_minus 95% upper bound <0 AND mu_plus 95% upper bound <0
outcome_patterns.decline_supported_increase_unresolved: mu_minus 95% upper bound <0 while the increasing class satisfies neither supported-positive nor supported-negative criterion

secondary_trend_class_contrast.terminology: Directional persistence may be called ratchet-compatible, not hysteresis. An unresolved increasing class is not evidence of decline-specificity.

boundaries: E is effective monitored-component number, not occupied area.
Species x MasterSite is a monitoring network, not assumed demographically closed.
Do not use kappa as the primary symmetry estimand because its sign changes when abundance trend changes.
Do not claim hysteresis from cross-panel symmetry alone.
Do not search traits, thresholds, lags, nonlinear trend classes, or alternative MasterSite/component definitions after delta_gamma is opened.
stop_rule: One execution after both structural and trend-balance gates pass. If the symmetry gate fails, this contract remains unexecuted.
